scope: 15 technical peer-review items and 12 internal audit items; the 21 editorial-only peer-review items remain unchanged.
coverage_rubric: The prior requirement-coverage estimates are retained without a percentage-point change. CEDIA receipt entries, file inventories, and repeated summaries do not count as closure unless they demonstrate a previously unmet reviewer requirement at its original unit and scope.

items.new_evidence: CEDIA reports zero exact (source, record) overlaps in each of four May cache train/validation pairs and reports matching hashes for the two published backbones. It also repeats previously documented V3C job/path receipts without adding trial-6 configuration or checkpoint bytes.
items.demonstrates: Only bounded cache-key disjointness and CEDIA-reported release-file hash corroboration.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Patient or signal independence, consumption of those caches by the June checkpoint jobs, complete pretraining lineage, or an untouched external cohort.
items.remaining_action: Require exact job-consumed manifests, patient/signal mappings in authorized storage, and full backbone lineage; independent validation remains a separate study.

items.new_evidence: CEDIA receipt metadata reports Plan AE/AF job states, two matching reported input digests, 23 handoff rows, reported profile metrics, and a gate-denied status.
items.demonstrates: A bounded, CEDIA-reported Plan AF output summary; not raw inference or a complete clinical workflow.
items.does_not_demonstrate: The June eligible population, exclusions, input-byte consumption, an ECG-level transition ledger, quarantine denominator, quarantine rate, or pre/post performance.
items.remaining_action: Obtain the exact AE policy/manifest bytes and complete linked denominator/transition/reference ledger, or keep historical quarantine not assessed.

items.new_evidence: No new AF clinical reference, adjudication, or longitudinal record was included.
items.demonstrates: No additional AF evidence relevant to the original comment.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Clinical correctness, AF onset, incident/first diagnosis, or longitudinal truth.
items.remaining_action: Keep claims at ECG-statement presence unless longitudinal adjudicated evidence is supplied.

items.new_evidence: CEDIA exports May launcher/preflight/test source copies and reports jobs 13169, 13172 and 13181 failed; the 41M databases remain absent in the bounded search.
items.demonstrates: Some historical launcher/source bytes and recorded failed job states are available for static review.
items.does_not_demonstrate: The original SQLite generations, complete trial history, winning configuration, or trial-to-checkpoint linkage; this is not the A10 correction itself.
items.remaining_action: Keep A10/Optuna in PR #4 and request original DB generations, consistent sidecars, full trial export and checkpoint promotion records from the custodian.

items.new_evidence: No all-class compatible reference population or validated Other output was recovered.
items.demonstrates: No additional evidence that changes the all-class coverage limit.
items.does_not_demonstrate: A complete ontology, Other performance, or all-input clinical utility.
items.remaining_action: Use a separately prespecified all-class study if an Other-performance claim is retained.

items.new_evidence: No new figure source archive, creator record, rights permission, or execution record was supplied.
items.demonstrates: No change to the prior bounded figure-provenance record.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Creator identity, third-party rights, or truth of the process depicted.
items.remaining_action: Obtain author/rightsholder confirmation before later manuscript edits.

items.new_evidence: CEDIA summarizes four May cache pairs with zero exact source-record key overlap; no patient identifier or June job-read evidence accompanies that summary.
items.demonstrates: A bounded key-level comparison in the named cache copies.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Patient-level separation, waveform deduplication, or the actual manifests consumed to produce released checkpoints.
items.remaining_action: Recover exact train/validation/calibration/selection manifests, patient maps and per-job read receipts.

items.new_evidence: CEDIA reports positive-row counts in the May PATHOLOGY_10 cache for the named auxiliary classes.
items.demonstrates: Those labels occur in a May cache, with PATHOLOGY_10_V2 duplicating the original cache bytes.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Effective loss support, active masks, training by V3F/V3AG, or checkpoint-linked auxiliary performance.
items.remaining_action: Recover per-checkpoint manifests, masks, effective class supports, loss configuration and class metrics.

items.new_evidence: The May cache summary supplies positive-label row counts for ALMI, ILMI and LAE; those aggregate counts were not linked to the released checkpoints.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Historically supervised examples, negative supports, active masks, job linkage, or evaluated class performance.
items.remaining_action: Keep performance claims unestablished until checkpoint-linked supervision/evaluation is evidenced or remove those claims in the later manuscript revision.

items.new_evidence: The Plan AF receipt reports a 23-row handoff summary but no individual role or review-action ledger.
items.demonstrates: Only an aggregate handoff count and gate status.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Historical per-record roles, actual medical review, or pre/post transitions.
items.remaining_action: Recover a role policy and record-linked action ledger, or later define Role narrowly as a software field.

items.new_evidence: CEDIA reaffirms that the September loader candidate is 32,051 raw bytes and does not match the expected 36,271-byte loader hash.
items.demonstrates: The candidate must not be represented as the historical V4.5 loader.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Exact loader identity, morphological-feature parity, or strict P4 replay equivalence; the residual remains above 1e-5.
items.remaining_action: Only reopen with the exact expected loader bytes and a job link; preserve the prior replay residual and tolerance.

items.new_evidence: CEDIA-reported split-key checks and backbone hashes add bounded corroboration but do not complete source provenance.
items.demonstrates: Only the limited facts stated in the two source claims.
items.does_not_demonstrate: An untouched cohort or absence of overlap across all backbone pretraining/fine-tuning sources.
items.remaining_action: Retain transfer versus independent-validation distinction; a new independent study requires separate eligibility and non-consultation controls.

items.new_evidence: Two AF summaries report aggregate primary-scope metrics and a handoff count but deny the external gate.
items.demonstrates: A CEDIA-reported aggregate Plan AF summary only.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Per-record routing, model/checkpoint identity, a complete no-label-routing path, or that handoff rows are quarantine events.
items.remaining_action: Keep empty sets, fallback, handoff, quarantine and human review distinct; require linked input bytes and record-level transitions for historical claims.

items.new_evidence: The receipt reports matching AE input digests, 23 AF handoff rows and `valid_for_gate=0`; it does not provide the policy/manifest bytes or a complete eligible denominator.
items.demonstrates: A bounded execution-summary report and that the reported external gate was not passed.
items.does_not_demonstrate: A quarantine rate, zero quarantines, uncertainty-score thresholding, or pre/post error movement.
items.remaining_action: Obtain the exact policy, score, full denominator, references and per-record pre/post ledger; until then quarantine is NOT_ASSESSED, not zero.

items.new_evidence: No beat annotations, timing references, or episode-level outcomes were included.
items.demonstrates: No change to the record-level scope boundary.
items.does_not_demonstrate: Beat detection, localization, or episode counts.
items.remaining_action: Keep the claim at record-level ECG statements or conduct a separate beat-annotated study.
